text:
Samir: Quick share  two life things: promoted to Engineering Manager (woo!) and Lina and I just celebrated our 2nd anniversary this weekend 60d planning a tiny office drop-in Fri 4pm for cupcakes + karaoke (no pressure).
Lina: Surprise double-toast! Thanks for all the love this weekend 970 we had tacos and a terrible dance-off. Karaoke is absolutely happening.
Aisha: Congrats Samir + Lina!! :tada: I can bring cupcakes and a Bluetooth speaker for karaoke. What vibe playlist should we start with?
Tom: Massive congrats. I'll bring savory snacks and paper cups. Karaoke rec: start with mellow then peak with cheesy 00s bangers.
Samir: Promo effective next Monday, HR looped in. Thanks so much. No gifts please 60a just vibes and maybe one terribly sung duet.
RexBot: Office note: kitchen reserved Fri 16:00-17:00 by Samir. Please label perishables.
HRBot: Promo confirmation sent to Samir. Reminder: update badge title here: https://hr.internal/badges. Congrats!
Aisha: Song recs drop here: "Toxic (cover)", "Mr Brightside", "Don't Stop Believin'". Also can someone bring a mic?
Tom: I have a wired mic we can borrow. Also bringing a tiny banner that says "2+2=Party" (math not required).
Lina: This is perfect. Speaker + mic + cupcakes = my kind of math. I'll bring a silly photo slideshow of the weekend.
Samir: Remote folks included: I'll post Zoom link. If you want to sing remotely, DM me and I'll queue you in. Thanks everyone 44f
Aisha: RSVP: yes. Cupcake flavors request: chocolate, lemon, salted caramel? Vote with emoji.
Tom: :one: chocolate
Lina: :three: salted caramel
Samir: :one: chocolate
Aisha: Chocolate wins. I'll order a mixed box anyway. See you Fri 4pm for cupcakes and painfully earnest karaoke.
Tom: I will warm up my vocal cords. Warning: I do an excellent kitchen sink impression.
RexBot: Reminder scheduled Fri 15:45 local: "Cupcakes + Karaoke for Samir & Lina"
Lina: You all are the best. See you Friday 60a
